comments.body:
> I haven’t been having the greatest time— have been using a lot of hints while working through.

I think most of us are in the same boat here, so I guess that's pretty normal. 😅

If I'm being honest, if you're only halfway through you still have a lot ahead of yourself (and keep in mind that some problems in the later weeks are pretty tricky), but if you can affort to devote those two weeks mainly to AlgoLab, I suppose it should be doable if you make sure to not spend too much time on each of the problems if you're stuck.

I think for some easier problems it might be enough to just look at the solution (for example something like "India" is pretty easy to understand, assuming you understand the concept of max flows), but for others it's just not the same if you at least haven't tried to come up with a solution yourself. I personally had a lot of trouble understanding the solutions of others just by looking at it, and I had to code it out myself (in my own way) to really get it.

If you still decide to go for it, perhaps a good approach would be to choose 1-2 different problems from each category, so you've at least practiced each of them once.

Good luck, let's hope they are merciful with us this year. :v
comments.author: Vallaaris
